title: Stimulation with EphB-Fc induces spine maturation in cultured rat hippocampal neurons
protocol: Treat CVS with nitric acid overnight.
Wash CVS briefly with H<sub>2</sub>O five times, each wash for 30 minutes.
Spread washed CVS on Whatmann paper to dry.
Bake dried CVS at 165°C overnight in the oven.
Place CVS into sterile 24-well plates.
Coat CVS with 400 μl/well poly-D-lysine in Borate-Buffer (1 mg/ml) for more than five hours in the incubator.
Wash coated CVS three times with H<sub>2</sub>O and allow to dry in the hood.
Coat washed CVS with 5 μg/ml laminin in PBS for at least two hours in the incubator (400 μl/well).
Wash laminin-coated CVS three times with PBS.
Replace PBS with NB medium (400 μl/well) and place into the incubator.
Pre-warm 4 ml of SM and 4 ml of NB medium in a dish in the incubator.
Pre-warm trypsin at 37°C in the water bath.
Take E18-19 rat embryos, cut off heads and collect them in a dish with chilled dissection medium (DM).
Carefully open the skull of collected embryos, remove brains, and transfer to a new dish with chilled DM.
Separate cortices from the rest of the brain, remove meninges, and cut out hippocampi; collect hippocampi in a 15 ml tube filled with 10 ml DM on ice.
Remove DM from collected hippocampi.
Replace DM with 1-2 ml warmed trypsin and incubate at 37°C for 20 minutes in the water bath.
Flame Pasteur pipette to decrease the diameter of the tip.
Take off trypsin and wash hippocampi twice with 1 ml warm SM.
Add 1.5 ml SM and homogenize tissue using the fire-polished Pasteur pipette by pipetting up and down 20-30 times.
Centrifuge for 5 minutes at 80g (650rpm).
Remove supernatant, resuspend neurons in 1-3 ml pre-warmed NB medium using the fire-polished Pasteur pipette.
Count cells and plate them at designated cell density (e.g., high density 25,000 cells/cm²) on prepared CVS.
Mix 900 μl fresh NB medium with Transfection Mix containing: 37.5 μl H₂O, DNA (4-7 μg), 12.5 μl 1M CaCl₂, and 50 μl BBS.
Mix H₂O with CaCl₂.
Add DNA to the mixture and mix slowly by pipetting.
Add BBS to the DNA-H₂O-CaCl₂-mixture.
Mix the transfection mixture with 900 μl warm NB medium using a vortex.
Take away old medium from cells and apply 250 μl of the transfection-medium mix to each of the 4 wells.
Incubate for 1.5-2.5 hours.
Warm up HBSS for washing.
Wash cells with pre-warmed HBSS until most of the precipitate is removed.
Add 300 μl of NB medium per well to the cells.
Stimulate 2 days later.
Mix EphB/ephrin 4 μg/ml with anti-hFc at 0.2 μg/ml.
Incubate the mixture for one hour at room temperature.
Stimulate cells by adding the clustered EphB, ephrin, or Fc solution to wells at a concentration of 4 μg/ml for 8 hours in an incubator.
Place cells on ice to stop the reaction.
Remove medium and fix cells with 200 μl/well 4% PFA (in 4% sucrose) for 12 minutes on ice.
Wash cells twice with cold PBS.
Remove PBS and treat cells with 200 μl/well cold NH₄Cl for 10 minutes on ice.
Wash cells twice with cold PBS.
Wash cells once with room temperature PBS for 5 minutes.
Wash cells with H₂O.
Apply a drop of H₂O to the glass slide and mount cells using Gel/Mount anti-fading medium.
Take pictures using an epifluorescence microscope.
Analyze changes in spine length and spine head size using MetaMorph software.
